subject.title: Manage Claw cron jobs through the gateway

question: Should the experimental Claws series own persistent Gateway cron declarations and their lifecycle state in core, or should scheduled work remain outside this initial Claws contract?
rationale: This is a new durable core capability spanning Gateway scheduling, agent lifecycle, export, and SQLite state; code review cannot decide whether that permanent product boundary belongs in the approved Claws roadmap.

options.title: Sponsor the cron lifecycle slice
options.body: Accept Gateway-owned Claw cron declarations as part of the experimental series, contingent on base-PR sequencing and real Gateway proof.

options.title: Defer scheduled work
options.body: Keep the broader Claws lifecycle narrower for now and move cron ownership to a later maintainer-approved design.

options.title: Route scheduling outside core
options.body: Require a plugin or external package boundary if maintainers do not want Claws to persist scheduler ownership in core state.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the cron lifecycle slice
recommendation.body: Accept Gateway-owned Claw cron declarations as part of the experimental series, contingent on base-PR sequencing and real Gateway proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He supplied the concrete lifecycle requirements for this feature and is assigned on the PR timeline.
